newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Foreign equity levels in Malaysia to grow - Anwar.
newsitem.headline: Foreign equity levels in Malaysia to grow - Anwar.

text.p: Malaysia's limits on equity ownership in domestic companies by foreigners will eventually have to go up, Malaysian Finance Secretary Anwar Ibrahim said on Sunday.
But he gave no time frame.
Asked by Reuters Financial Television about possible further liberalisation of ownership, Anwar said foreign firms "should be comfortable with 49 percent of the equity", the current limit.
However, he added that gradually the level would have to move up. "I think ultimately it will have to happen."
Anwar was in Cebu for a meeting of Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum finance ministers.
